@graph.name: Juicy Designs
@graph.slogan: We make brands impossible to ignore
@graph.description: Juicy Designs is a founder-led full-service digital marketing agency and promotion company based in Pretoria, South Africa. Established in 2015 by Cobus van der Westhuizen and Wynand van der Westhuizen, the agency delivers strategy, design, advertising and social media marketing intended to turn attention into revenue. Its in-house full-funnel services include search engine optimisation, AI search optimisation covering AEO and GEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, paid social, social media marketing, web design, web development, branding, content production, lead generation, email marketing and conversion-focused landing pages. Clients work directly with the founders rather than account managers, junior staff or outsourced teams. Juicy Designs serves businesses across Pretoria, Gauteng and South Africa, including automotive, entertainment, food and beverage, industrial, insurance, retail, professional services and healthcare organisations. The business reports serving more than 64 clients, a weighted average 4.8x return on ad spend across 38 active Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts from January 2025 to April 2026, and a 4.9 out of 5 Google rating from 214 reviews verified in May 2026.
